external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Regional technology partnership to connect the CONTOUR™NEXT ONE meter with the Balansio mobile app (acquired by ProWellness), which includes a calculator for bolus insulin dosing for people with type 1 diabetes.

Global technology partnership with Glooko to integrate their data management platform with our CONTOUR™NEXT ONE and CONTOUR™PLUS ONE systems to allow blood glucose data to be accessed by patients via Glooko’s Mobile App and by HCPs via Glooko’s Clinic Data Upload products.

Regional collaboration in Asian markets to provide an offering for people with diabetes that is comprised of the CONTOUR™PLUS ELITE or CONTOUR®PLUS ONE blood glucose monitoring systems, the Health2Sync app and a loyalty program for users, known as the Ascensia Customer Care Program.

Global technology partnership to connect the CONTOUR™NEXT ONE and CONTOUR™PLUS ONE meters via Bluetooth to the Insulia® Diabetes Management Companion from Voluntis which can help calculate basal insulin dosing for people with type 2 diabetes.

Global collaboration with SNAQ's app-based solution that offers key insights on food and nutrition for people living with diabetes (PWDs), and Ascensia's CONTOUR™ BGM portfolio and data management systems, to empower PWDs to make positive mealtime decisions.
Regional collaboration in the US enabling distribution of the CONTOUR™NEXT ONE blood glucose monitoring system by 9am.health to complement their all-in-one virtual diabetes care platform.

Strategic partnership to support the market introduction of Sava’s innovative wearable microsensor technology, comprising an exclusive commercialization and distribution agreement, initially in Europe, and a financing agreement.
Investment in Senseonics, developer of Eversense®, the first and only long-term implantable Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) system.

Minority investment to support development and commercialization of Biolinq's innovative microneedle based intradermal sensor (biowearable) that is capable of measuring glucose and other metabolic analytes in real-time.

Regional collaboration in the US with integration of the CONTOUR™NEXT ONE blood glucose monitoring system by Current Health, as part of Best Buy Health, to provide a unique solution for healthcare organizations, combining cutting-edge technology and clinical expertise with retail scale and in-home support services.
